scope: Intel module name contiguous mapping prefix recovery
implementation: Reuse pinned-compatible Intel Linux64 mappings; stop at the first mapping gap, reject an empty prefix, propagate mapped read failures. ARM64 retains full-field reads.
test_correction: lsmod_unreadable_name_never_becomes_a_prefix_row now declares a module size covering the relocated name and rejects ISF field-bound errors. Earlier versions could pass through layout rejection rather than captured-memory failure.
